payload.name: Capability Gap Scanner
payload.method: Find tasks where frontier agents reason well but lack live data, exhaustive measurement, persistence, deterministic action, or verification.

payload.name: Pricing Mismatch Scanner
payload.method: Find occasional-use paid utilities whose marginal execution cost is near zero and whose subscription model is poorly matched to usage.

payload.name: Domain Intelligence
payload.problem: Agents can invent names but cannot reliably establish live availability, renewal price, history and conflicts at scale.

payload.name: Redirect Chain Primitive
payload.problem: A deterministic network primitive is repeatedly packaged behind bloated SEO products.

payload.name: Generic PDF Summarizer
payload.problem: Generic PDF summarization is already native to frontier models.

payload.name: Subscription Unbundling Miner
payload.method: Find expensive recurring software attached to an inherently episodic job; replace with one excellent free/transactional utility exposed as REST+MCP.

payload.name: RevenueCat Category Miner
payload.method: Mine RevenueCat SOSA categories for high reactivation + low retention + monthly-plan dominance (episodicity signals).

payload.name: AI Churn Wave Miner
payload.method: Hunt AI-native <$50/mo products with GRR<40% — transactional demand masquerading as subscription demand.

payload.name: Unbundle Productivity Utilities
payload.problem: Productivity apps show highest reactivation (users leave and return per task) yet lock episodic users into monthly plans (77% monthly mix).

payload.name: Unbundle AI Utilities (<$50/mo)
payload.problem: AI-native products under $50/mo retain only 23% GRR / 32% NRR while AI Utilities revenue grew 2990% — transactional demand disguised as ARR.

payload.name: Unbundle Task Utilities
payload.problem: Task-based utility tools carry subscriptions although users need specific answers occasionally; reactivation is high, retention low.

payload.name: Unbundle Education Packs
payload.problem: Education has the highest median annual price ($44.99) but goal-oriented usage: students need exam-duration access, not perpetual renewal.

payload.name: Unbundle Photo & Video Jobs
payload.problem: Photo & Video is structurally pick-up/put-down (RevenueCat): one wedding, one resume photo, one render — yet sold as monthly plans.

payload.name: LLM Deal Intelligence
payload.problem: Users compare 400+ model/provider price combinations manually; effective cost varies by routing/cache/batch.

payload.name: Deal Terms Normalizer
payload.problem: Promotion pages are written for persuasion, not machine comparison; no normalized offer DSL exists.

payload.name: Return Eligibility Resolver
payload.problem: Return policies are 4000-word documents; consumers need a decision with deadline and fees.

payload.name: Subscription Cancellation Resolver
payload.problem: 52% cancelled a subscription last year mostly from non-use; cancellation paths are deliberately obscure.

payload.name: Domain Finder + Live Buying
payload.problem: Naming plus live RDAP verification plus registrar comparison exists nowhere in one free flow; affiliate economics fund it.

payload.name: Airline Baggage Resolver
payload.problem: Baggage rules vary by airline/fare/route/codeshare; travelers face fragmented sources.

payload.name: Job-Specific Resume Tailor
payload.problem: Resume.io charges £19.95/4wks for what is naturally one CV+job->PDF job.

payload.name: True Landed-Cost Calculator
payload.problem: Sticker price is useless cross-border; duty+tax+shipping math is scattered.

payload.name: Warranty Coverage Resolver
payload.problem: Warranty terms are scattered PDFs; eligibility is rules over brand/model/date/region.

payload.name: Product Manual Assistant
payload.problem: Appliance errors require finding exact manual revision; answers must cite exact page.

payload.name: Invoice/Receipt Normalizer
payload.problem: OCR is commodity; accounting-ready structured records are the job.

payload.name: Audio to Transcript+Actions
payload.problem: Otter charges $17/mo; most need one lecture/interview transcribed once.

payload.name: SaaS Plan Resolver
payload.problem: Software trials convert at 16.6% partly because plan selection is opaque constraint-solving.

payload.name: Startup Credits Eligibility
payload.problem: Directories list programs; nobody resolves personalized eligibility with stacking rules.

payload.name: Plant Identifier Without Subscription
payload.problem: PictureThis charges $39.99/yr for identification-heavy utility in the fastest-growing AI category.

payload.name: Exam Study-Pack Generator
payload.problem: Quizlet sells recurring access; the natural unit is one course/exam pack with FSRS scheduling.

payload.name: AI Room Redesign Per Render
payload.problem: Interior design tools charge monthly; demand is per-render.

payload.name: Niche Pronunciation Tutor Factory
payload.problem: ELSA proves $20/mo demand; narrow niches share one alignment/scoring engine.

payload.name: x402 Intent Resolver
payload.problem: Agent capability markets lack discovery/ranking; asymmetric upside option.

payload.name: Buyable-by-Date Product Resolver
payload.problem: Rufus shoppers convert ~2x; deadline+budget constrained purchasing is unsolved.

requirements.description: Publish a current llms.txt describing canonical machine-readable resources.
Expose Markdown alternates where they materially improve machine consumption.
Use a describedby relation to applicable machine-readable site description where supported.
Publish MCP endpoint and stable tool descriptions for callable capabilities.
Expose machine-readable per-call pricing and free-vs-metered status.
One stable canonical URL per public capability page.
Published sitemap for indexable public surfaces.
Explicit robots policy with no accidental blocking of public capability docs.
Structured data describing software/application capability where applicable.
Manifest declares id, name, domain, source.path, runtime, capabilities, interfaces, standards, sensors.
Homepage reachable; http.status observation present and healthy.
llms.txt and robots.txt return 2xx (satisfies agent-discovery v2 llms-txt requirement).
cloudflare-workers sites declare cloudflare_worker so api.calls/cf.errors flow via cf-usage; other runtimes attach middleware or declare an exemption in manifest.telemetry_exemptions.
Machine-readable health endpoint (e.g. /api/health) for cheap deep probes.
